line_items.reasoning: Q3 worldwide sales grew 5.4% operationally, tracking above the guided full-year operational growth midpoint of ~4.8%, and the second consecutive quarter above $15B in Innovative Medicine signals full-year revenue is on pace to exceed the raised guidance range.

Adjusted diluted EPS of $2.80 in Q3 is strong, but management explicitly reaffirmed the full-year midpoint of $10.85 (unchanged from Q2 guidance), indicating results are tracking exactly in line with prior guidance rather than prompting a further raise.

MedTech adjusted income before tax margin declined from 24.1% to 21% in Q3, and the segment continues to face macro headwinds and China VBP pressure, casting doubt on the full-year ~300 bps operating margin improvement that was expected to materialize in H2.
No update was provided in Q3 results to suggest net interest expense deviated materially from the guided $0–$100M range, so this is treated as tracking in line.

Tariff and pharmaceutical pricing policy uncertainty (including MFN discussions) remains unresolved, but no revision to the ~$200M tariff impact estimate was flagged, suggesting it is still tracking within the guided range.
